nodes.description: Private owner address of UniswapExchange; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as access-control gate in delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom, batchSend and _mints.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; written in approve and constructor, decremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting per-address sales; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist; read in ensure and set true in _mints, letting an address bypass sale checks.
Private minimum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, set in init and enforced in condition.
Private number of allowed sales per address, set in init and read in condition.
Address privileged in ensure; writable by owner through setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply, assigned in constructor.
Public constant decimals = 18; used to scale amounts in _mints and init.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a privileged spender/whitelist entry.
Public payable transfer() that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition().
Public payable transferFrom that performs allowance checks and raw unchecked balance mutations before calling ensure().
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without checks.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Privileged mint/whitelist function that sets balanceOf[spender] arbitrarily and marks canSale[spender]=true.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum sale parameters.
Owner-only batch distribution loop that computes total = _value * _tos.length and mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Owner-only setter of the privileged tradeAddress variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair-address derivation using CREATE2 init code hash.
Constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, minting totalSupply to deployer and granting max allowance to the UNI router.
Caller-controlled address used for access-control checks, allowance accounting and ownership assignment.
Arbitrary delegatecall(a, b) executed in contract storage context, allowing an owner-supplied address to seize the contract.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath.
total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf mutations performed without SafeMath, allowing overflow of the total check.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls require(ensure(_from, _to, _value)) to gate every transfer.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] to authorize third-party transfers.
transferFrom rewrites balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every transfer.
The unchecked subtractions/additions of balances inside transferFrom flow into the unchecked mutation node.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)) for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() whitelists transfers when _from or _to equals the owner.
ensure() whitelists transfers when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure() whitelists transfers when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure() derives the expected Uniswap pair via pairFor for the whitelist comparison.
condition() reads _saleNum to decide the sale limit.
condition() compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() enforces the _minSale lower bound.
condition() enforces the _maxSale upper bound.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address and calldata, giving full control over contract storage.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an arbitrary value.
_mints() sets canSale[spender] = true, bypassing the sale restrictions enforced by ensure/condition.
_mints() requires msg.sender to be the owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
_mints() scales addedValue by 10**decimals.
init() writes the minimum sale amount _minSale.
init() writes the maximum sale amount _maxSale.
init() writes the per-address sale count limit _saleNum.
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
init() scales token and maxToken by 10**decimals.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length unbounded, flowing into the unchecked multiplication node.
batchSend() directly increments/decrements balanceOf without SafeMath.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() rewrites the privileged tradeAddress used inside ensure().
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the deployer the sole privileged actor.
Constructor mints totalSupply into balanceOf[msg.sender].
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the supplied _supply.
Constructor scales _supply by 10**decimals.
msg.sender becomes the owner in the constructor, capturing all owner-only privileges.
msg.sender is compared against owner and a hardcoded privileged address in _mints.
msg.sender is compared against owner before the arbitrary delegatecall.
msg.sender is compared against owner before batchSend.
msg.sender is compared against owner before init.
msg.sender determines whether the allowance branch of transferFrom is taken.
approve() records msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the source of the delegated transferFrom.
transfer recipient _to flows into transferFrom.
transfer amount _value flows into transferFrom.
ensure uses _from for all whitelist comparisons that decide whether a transfer is allowed.
ensure uses _to to check the owner and pair whitelist.
ensure forwards _value into condition to validate sale limits.
transferFrom debit address _from controls whose balance and allowance are modified.
transferFrom credit address _to receives the tokens.
transferFrom amount _value feeds the unchecked balance mutations.
approve spender _spender is stored in the allowance mapping.
approve amount _value is stored in the allowance mapping.
condition uses _from to read _onSaleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale and _maxSale.
delegatecall target a is fully caller-supplied, enabling arbitrary code execution.
delegatecall calldata b is fully caller-supplied.
_mints assigns an arbitrary balance to spender.
_mints scaled addedValue is a caller-supplied arbitrary mint amount.
init saleNum parameter is written to _saleNum.
init token parameter becomes _minSale.
init maxToken parameter becomes _maxSale.
batchSend recipient array _tos drives the distribution loop.
batchSend _value is multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath.
setTradeAddress assigns caller-supplied addr to the privileged tradeAddress.
pairFor factory parameter is hashed into the pair address.
pairFor tokenA participates in the CREATE2 address derivation.
pairFor tokenB participates in the CREATE2 address derivation.
Loop index i drives the iteration over _tos in batchSend.
Local _to = _tos[i] receives the batchSend credit.
Local total = _value * _tos.length is compared against balanceOf[msg.sender] before unchecked debits.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used as a forwarding argument into transferFrom via transfer(), so it is folded into the transfer function node.
_value is only forwarded by transfer() into transferFrom, so it collapses into the transfer function node.
_from is consumed by the whitelist logic inside ensure(), so it normalizes into the ensure function node.
_to is consumed by the whitelist logic inside ensure(), so it normalizes into the ensure function node.
_value is passed through ensure() into condition() where the sale limits are checked, so it merges into the condition function node.
_from selects the debited account and allowance entry in transferFrom, so it merges into the transferFrom node.
_to is the credited account inside transferFrom, so it merges into the transferFrom node.
_value drives the unchecked balance subtraction/addition in transferFrom, so it merges into the unchecked balance mutation unsafe operation.
_spender is stored directly in allowance inside approve(), so it merges into the approve function node.
_value is stored directly in allowance inside approve(), so it merges into the approve function node.
_from is used to look up _onSaleNum inside condition(), so it merges into the condition function node.
_value is compared against _minSale/_maxSale inside condition(), so it merges into the condition function node.
Address a is the target of the arbitrary delegatecall, so it merges into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Calldata b is the payload of the arbitrary delegatecall, so it merges into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
spender is granted an arbitrary balance and whitelist flag in _mints(), so it merges into the _mints function node.
addedValue is the arbitrary minted amount in _mints(), so it merges into the _mints function node.
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum in init(), so it merges into the init function node.
token becomes _minSale in init(), so it merges into the init function node.
maxToken becomes _maxSale in init(), so it merges into the init function node.
_tos is the recipient array iterated in batchSend(), so it merges into the batchSend function node.
_value feeds the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length computation, so it merges into the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
addr is written to tradeAddress in setTradeAddress(), so it merges into the setTradeAddress function node.
factory is hashed into the pair address in pairFor(), so it merges into the pairFor function node.
tokenA is part of the CREATE2 derivation in pairFor(), so it merges into the pairFor function node.
tokenB is part of the CREATE2 derivation in pairFor(), so it merges into the pairFor function node.
Loop counter i only exists inside batchSend(), so it merges into the batchSend function node.
Local _to = _tos[i] only exists inside batchSend(), so it merges into the batchSend function node.
Local total is the result of the unchecked multiplication checked against balanceOf[msg.sender], so it merges into the unchecked multiplication unsafe operation.
